meta.description: Creation for Passion: event styling in Catania and handmade creations born from a passion for making things by hand.

hero.title: Creating is our passion
hero.intro: We are Creation for Passion, a small creative workshop in Catania. We design event setups and hand-make creations that tell a story: yours.

story.title: It all started with handmade
story.paragraph1: We began by making wedding favours and small gifts for friends and family. Piece by piece, the passion became a job: today we look after entire events, from the first idea to the final setup.
story.paragraph2: We style events in Catania and the surrounding area, and we ship our creations across Italy and abroad.

passione.title: Passion
passione.text: It's in our name: every project starts from the wish to create something beautiful.

dettagli.title: Attention to detail
dettagli.text: From the centrepiece to the ribbon on a favour, nothing is left to chance.

meta.title: How we work
meta.description: From the first message to the day of the event: how we design your setups and make our creations to measure.

hero.title: From the first message to the day of the party
hero.intro: Whether it's an event setup or a handmade creation, we always work the same way: we listen, we design together and we craft every detail with care.

scrivi.title: You message us
scrivi.text: Send us a message on WhatsApp or social media: tell us what event you're planning or what you need.

conosciamo.title: We get to know you
conosciamo.text: We talk about the date, the style, the colours and what you have in mind. If you like, send us photos and inspiration.

idee.title: We share some ideas
idee.text: We tell you how we picture your event: ideas, colours and materials. We refine them together until you love them.

realizziamo.title: We make it happen
realizziamo.text: We make everything by hand. For event setups we take care of the venue on the day; creations are shipped to you.

anticipo.question: How far in advance should I contact you?
anticipo.answer: The sooner, the better. For a wedding it's best to write to us a few months ahead; for favours and creations it depends on the quantity. Message us and we'll tell you right away if your date is available.

zona.question: Do you only work in Catania?
zona.answer: We style events in Catania and the surrounding area. Our handmade creations ship across Italy and abroad.

personalizzare.question: Can I personalise a creation?
personalizzare.answer: Yes, it's what we love doing most: names, dates, colours and materials are chosen together.

informazioni.question: How can I get more information?
informazioni.answer: Message us on WhatsApp or social media with the type of event, the date and an idea of the style you like: we'll answer any question.

cta.title: Let's take the first step
cta.text: Message us on WhatsApp: it's the quickest way to tell us your idea.

meta.title: Privacy and cookies
meta.description: How we handle the data of people who visit the site or contact us, and which cookies we use.

hero.title: Privacy and cookie policy
hero.intro: A few clear lines on which data passes through this site, why, and how you can exercise your rights.

titolare.title: Who the data controller is
titolare.text: The data controller is {owner}, who runs {name}. For any privacy question you can write to {email}.

dati.title: What data we process
dati.text: The site has no contact forms, needs no sign-up and uses no analytics or profiling tools. The only data processed is:

items.navigazione: Browsing data: when you visit the site, the server hosting it automatically logs technical information such as IP address, browser, requested page, date and time. This keeps the site running and protects it from abuse.
items.cookie: Technical cookies: the site only uses the NEXT_LOCALE cookie, which remembers the language you chose (Italian or English) and is deleted when you close the browser.
items.contatti: Data you send us: if you write to us on WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or by email, we receive your name, number or profile and the content of your message.

finalita.title: Why we process it
finalita.text: Browsing data and the technical cookie are needed to show you the site and keep it secure, based on our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). The data you send us is used only to answer your requests and prepare quotes and orders, based on pre-contractual and contractual measures (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

cookie.title: Cookies
cookie.text: We only use technical cookies that the site needs to work, so your consent is not required and you will not see a banner. We use no profiling or third-party cookies. You can still delete cookies in your browser settings: the site keeps working but goes back to the default language.

hosting.title: Where the site is hosted
hosting.text: The site is hosted by Vercel Inc. (United States), which processes browsing data on our behalf as data processor. Data is transferred to the United States in line with the GDPR, under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

terzi.title: Links to WhatsApp and social media
terzi.text: The WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook buttons are plain links: no data is sent to these platforms until you click one. Once you are on the platform, your data is handled under its own privacy policy.

conservazione.title: How long we keep it
conservazione.text: Browsing data is kept by the hosting provider only as long as strictly needed, usually a few days. We keep our conversations with you as long as needed to handle your request or order, and for any legal obligations.

diritti.title: Your rights
diritti.text: At any time you can write to {email} to:

items.accesso: find out what data we hold about you and get a copy;
items.cancellazione: ask for it to be deleted;
items.limitazione: restrict or object to its processing;
items.portabilita: receive it in a readable format to move it elsewhere;
items.reclamo: lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (garanteprivacy.it).

modifiche.title: Changes
modifiche.text: If we change how we handle data, for example by adding a contact form or analytics, we will update this page and the date at the top.
